scene_description: Three separate food packages on a gray table: a blue chip bag near the front, a wrapped lemon loaf behind it, and a large clear-lidded food container farther back and to the right.

targets.name: food container
targets.description: Tan square food container with a clear lid and white label, behind and to the right of the lemon loaf package.
targets.clearance_notes: Top and side faces are exposed. No other package rests on its lid; nearby packages leave alternate approach directions open. The target is set back from the front accessible edge; bringing it forward could reduce the approach distance even though some surfaces are exposed.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift or route around the other packages rather than pushing through them. Move the food container approximately 20 cm toward the front edge of the table, into a clear position while keeping the entire object supported.

targets.other_notes: Front means the foreground edge in images/01.jpg.

targets.name: blue chip bag
targets.description: Blue snack bag with a white nutrition panel, lying nearest the front edge of the table, in front of the lemon loaf.
targets.clearance_notes: Top, front, and side edges are exposed with open tabletop around them.
targets.other_notes: User-provided size describes the filled bag; its shape can deform.

targets.name: lemon loaf
targets.description: Yellow lemon loaf slice in a clear wrapper with a black label, between the blue bag and the large food container.
nearby_obstacles: Blue bag near one wrapper edge
Large food container behind and to the right
targets.clearance_notes: Top is exposed and the package is not stacked beneath another object. Side access remains available. The target is set back from the front accessible edge; bringing it forward could reduce the approach distance even though some surfaces are exposed.

candidate_improvements.description: Place it beside, rather than on top of, the blue bag. Move the lemon loaf approximately 10 cm toward the front edge of the table, into a clear position while keeping the entire object supported.

targets.other_notes: Dimensions interpreted as the packaged loaf exterior shown in the photos. Front means the foreground edge in images/01.jpg.

source: Staged permutation of S0022 and S0024, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
